faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Where does Nowing get its lead and business data?
faq.a1: Nowing aggregates and verifies data in real-time from 15+ public platforms across Vietnam including Batdongsan, Chợ Tốt, TopCV, ITviec, National Procurement (muasamcong), Official Business Registries, Facebook public groups, and Shopee/TikTok.
faq.q2: Is the phone resolution accurate and verified for Zalo?
faq.a2: Yes. Our 3-tier waterfall resolution verifies mobile number formats, cleans prefixes (+84/0), and validates active Zalo OA / Telegram endpoints with over 99.2% accuracy.
faq.q3: How does the $0 Chat & Pay-as-you-go pricing work?
faq.a3: You can chat with AI, formulate lead queries, and browse results completely free ($0). You only spend credits when you decide to decrypt phone numbers (1.5 credits = $0.0015) or run heavy web crawler automations.
faq.q4: Can I export leads to my CRM or Excel?
faq.a4: Yes, you can export your lead tables with one click to CSV, Excel, Lark Base, or sync live via Zero-Cache and Webhook integrations.
